about:
I'm an Android Developer with a background in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (class of 2022). Since March 2024 I've been building the Android app of Bidsee, a live-stream auction and e-commerce platform, at Sotech Bilgi Teknolojileri — live streaming with AWS IVS and WebRTC, real-time WebSocket messaging, payments and app performance.

On my own time I build and publish apps with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and I ship developer tools such as the SmartCodeSorter IntelliJ plugin.

**10+** Projects Built  ·  **3+** Years Experience  ·  **2** Platforms
